verdict.rationale: Convex documents a first-party `npx convex export` command that exports deployment data to a ZIP file and lists data Import & Export for interoperability. The open-source, self-hostable backend gives a documented exit path off the cloud service. However, the evidence never says what format the ZIP contents use, and never confirms that everything (e.g. file storage) is included. Missing for 10: documentation of the open file formats inside the export, confirmation that the export covers all data including file storage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a full migration out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: npx convex export — Export data from your deployment to a ZIP file
you can run the Convex backend on your own servers. Self-hosted Convex runs the open-source backend, and contains the same fully up-to-date code the cloud service uses.
